_doc: Assumed economics for manufacturing_iot. Every value is 'assumed' and carries its basis.

retention_sensitivity_per_health_point.basis: assumed: device fleets and plant deployments renew on annual support and expand by site; a 50-point health span is taken to move 12-month revenue by ~15% of the base, i.e. 0.3% per point

revenue_at_risk_share_by_band.basis: assumed: share of the account's annual revenue expected to be lost within the horizon (support not renewed, sites decommissioned), by health band
